# Election update: Wednesday, November 4 (morning)

## Bottom line
Democrats won control of both chambers, NPR, NBC News and CNN report ([NPR](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNZVhrSEZna25zZzkxdEROS2w2MGkwWmdJTlY2Y3Z3ZWxnQ1MwVzV1YXlDVkdOZ3NOVE5KOXZaVnhBTlBaTlNVSVd4NjdIbklVVGRNYlhIN2NzN0pPNk52aVJpQ1NERFJwZnJLWlZ3MzdqN0VPbWZvcS1qQjNaQXUtUzJKUkc5bTJ4UWc?oc=5), [NBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE9HT01FMldrNmE3Z1pmR3lRYmxaMVhxNDN1MF9maXpIV1hiU2xLWnpuWURkeEFhXzVEMmdjR3dreFgyeWZxZDYxTVVxSWh4cUFGMkc4N3Bja2RzQm1KS2x3clhsR0I2WVR4WXVOTUNtRQ?oc=5), [CNN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOWXFCZ1pzSTJKRWV4cXhvRFVkWFk1MWI3dVdXeU5KUE10MDRTNk5FQmkzUnZtQmVzbXcxYm9ZNU1ScnFkV2czWHRLVHM0OTRGRTItbGVYU1A1ckVRUThYNHRmOUZITXE2eG1neHJzUzBQLVdhWmtxaWZFUFp2eFZzUQ?oc=5)). In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up this year, with Alaska and Mississippi still uncalled ([results table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). In the House, 210 of 435 races are marked called (D 141, R 69) in the Wikipedia results table, which lags AP. The networks' control call is ahead of that count ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). No seat rated safe has a count within 5 points so far; vote shares are not yet posted in the table.

## Recounts and certification
- WLRN reports Rep. María Elvira Salazar leads in FL-27 by a margin close enough to trigger Florida's recount process ([WLRN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPcV9uenZrRV91ZS0xdDhuSXFNZVlhc2JHRHhHTXBMcWNQcVlZa21YRWxSb3BHVUMzc1ZxOU9yanJvTk5NSlQ5Y2t5VDJLRVE1bzc2bnhwd1NSMHhxX0lXMUtVV2JlV0hoaXdUQmo5bDNjaTVxY01yWURjZVR0YVVOWDZIc3hYN055c0E?oc=5)). No other recount is reported in the leads yet.
- Maine's ME-02 is reported too close to call ([Portland Press Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9mdjRORjdnSVN1b3ExSkpTSFpqX3AwODZTVk9jd2RpeTNpblFqWlFDWnU2SnE1ZmNHWEg0S0tiWVp4dzlhVS1OM243Rzh1STA?oc=5)); Maine uses ranked-choice tabulation if no one clears 50%. Certification steps begin this week; none is reported yet.

## Legal and federal action
- **Alaska:** CNBC reports, citing others' reporting, that the Justice Department sent target letters to Democrats in its criminal probe tied to the Alaska Senate race, which is uncalled ([CNBC](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **California:** The Supreme Court rejected the administration's request to intervene in a California ballot case ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPU3dhcGtsWC1YU2dGcG83cm05WWs1aU9mXzlIZFZoWjYxbGJwN2VGdENKU1JLLUNaMTVwRFZqZEhIYXFxQy1ZNE9RSkVvaF84WmxtLU1xNnRYTDZvSTRkbktueEd4bG9YQnotMF9uQnB0WERoaHRaa3NpaElQYUxzMHZHaXY5LUxxQjluQzVJSi14eGsw?oc=5)). The LA Times reports federal election monitors were deployed to Los Angeles as the Ninth Circuit sided with the administration in a separate ballot dispute ([LA Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOSEdUSHRmSnFST0F1NFdVTGtDUXljSnZjT3VnU0dPc1ZscHFQVW82V1lBLWNNeHF3SzJYN0NUV1g2NEI0ZGQ2YlMxRzZpQ1otRFFaaGtrdm52SDdudmZrendpaVFyZldNODRxV3Q5ajhuU2VUWnpvcVFHa2lqTGJuN1g3anhxSS1fUWVseVVYbDB6OXo5ZmdKdk94YVZDcFI3Y3prZlU4ZWg3UQ?oc=5)).
- **Courts overall:** Reuters reports the administration's Supreme Court winning streak in election cases has stopped ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPSm80SFVkQkVfVVVlRjdDZDhDVDFiTk9sMTFRRGhxNGYwczJwd1pSYXNxQWttQ0p6YXhyQno3U0w3YWdVR3pEX1VrZ1B0ak1BVWh6MGs4YWh2Y3JTOWhSQ2cyMXgzS2Q0a0MyMWFtS21EQzljT0RtZGM5R3pMQW5zMW14bHNJcG1LNDZ6cS1LOGlJVGIyenNOa3AxR3Nlb0lFS0NjeHM2Ql9zSXVtT2NVeXVTQnpsUVUtMFE?oc=5)). Claims by officials of either side remain claims until a court or election office acts.

## Coverage note
- **Sources:** 28 of 28 sources reported. Both results tables parsed (435 House, 35 Senate) and passed the parser check. Race news queries ran with no errors.
- **Table lag:** vote shares and many safe-seat calls are not yet posted in the Wikipedia tables.
- **Not used:** CourtListener needs an account key, so court items come from news reports.
- **Scorecard:** preliminary (41% of competitive races called), so lessons learned are omitted today.
